laws.rule: Nairobi City County: the county assembly states that section 20 of the Public Nuisance Act 2021 prohibits musical instruments, amplifiers and similar equipment making loud, continuous or repeated noise that is a nuisance to neighbouring occupants or street passers-by.

sources.title: Assembly motion on control of noise pollution; cites Public Nuisance Act 2021 section 20
sources.supports: Assembly description of section 20 read directly; the Act text itself was not accessible on the assembly Act page.
